title: Unknown-Problem Detection Engine — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. A tool specification alone does not make an otherwise impossible technology achievable. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Identifies gaps, anomalies, and unexplained observations that are not covered by predefined problem categories. A proposed engine that looks for what nobody asked it to look for: gaps in coverage, anomalies that do not fit any known category, and observations that current models cannot explain. Rather than classifying inputs into predefined buckets, it flags the unclassifiable — the residuals of our understanding — and characterizes what makes each one strange.
capabilities: Detect observations that fit no predefined category
Map coverage gaps across a problem space
Characterize anomalies by what makes them strange
Rank unknowns by potential importance
Feed confirmed unknowns into problem-definition workflows
